mapper.insert: /* setReadingGoal */ INSERT INTO TM_GOALXM ( USER_NUMB , GOAL_DATE , GOAL_TYPE , GOAL_CNTT , UPDT_CNTT , REGI_DATE , UPDT_DATE ) VALUES ( #{userNumb} , #{goalDate} , #{goalType} , #{goalCnt} , 0 , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) AS NEW ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE UPDT_CNTT = CASE WHEN NEW.GOAL_CNTT < TM_GOALXM.GOAL_CNTT THEN COALESCE(TM_GOALXM.UPDT_CNTT, 0) + 1 ELSE COALESCE(TM_GOALXM.UPDT_CNTT, 0) END , GOAL_CNTT = NEW.GOAL_CNTT , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT /* getReportDtl */ A.REPT_NUMB , A.USER_NUMB , A.BOOK_NUMB , A.REPT_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{codeReadStat}, A.REPT_STAT, NULL, #{languageCode}) AS REPT_STAT_NAME , A.REPT_STDT , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CLPART PART INNER JOIN TM_CLRNDX ROUNDX ON ROUNDX.CLUB_NUMB = PART.CLUB_NUMB AND ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB = PART.ROND_NUMB WHERE PART.REPT_NUMB = A.REPT_NUMB AND ROUNDX.ROND_STAT = #{roundReading} AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN DATE(ROUNDX.GOAL_STDT) AND DATE(ROUNDX.GOAL_ENDT) ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS REPT_STDT_LOCKED , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CLPART PART INNER JOIN TM_CLRNDX ROUNDX ON ROUNDX.CLUB_NUMB = PART.CLUB_NUMB AND ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB = PART.ROND_NUMB INNER JOIN TB_CLMEMX MEMBER ON MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = PART.CLUB_NUMB AND MEMBER.USER_NUMB = PART.USER_NUMB INNER JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = PART.USER_NUMB WHERE PART.REPT_NUMB = A.REPT_NUMB AND PART.USER_NUMB = A.USER_NUMB AND PART.GOAL_YSNO IS NULL AND ROUNDX.ROND_STAT = #{roundReading} AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberActive} AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS CLUB_READING_REPORT , A.REPT_ENDT , A.REPT_GRDE , A.REPT_COLR , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{codeBookColr}, A.REPT_COLR, NULL, #{languageCode}) AS REPT_COLR_NAME , A.PUBC_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{codeCommYsno}, A.PUBC_YSNO, #{optPubcYsno}, #{languageCode}) AS PUBC_YSNO_NAME , A.LKAL_YSNO AS LIKE_ALIM_YSNO , A.RPAL_YSNO AS REPLY_ALIM_YSNO , A.REPT_CNTN , SHA2(CONCAT_WS('|' , COALESCE(A.LANG_CODE, '') , COALESCE(A.REPT_STAT, '') , COALESCE(A.REPT_STDT, '') , COALESCE(A.REPT_ENDT, '') , COALESCE(A.REPT_GRDE, '') , COALESCE(A.REPT_COLR, '') , COALESCE(A.PUBC_YSNO, '') , COALESCE(A.REPT_CNTN, '') ), 256) AS EDIT_VERSION , COALESCE(LC.LIKE_CNT, 0) AS LIKE_CNT , COALESCE(UL.LIKE_YSNO, #{commNo}) AS LIKE_YSNO , COALESCE(RC.REPL_CNT, 0) AS REPL_CNT , B.BOOK_TITL , B.BOOK_ATHR , B.BOOK_CVIM , B.BOOK_ISBN , B.BOOK_PUBL , B.BOOK_DESC , FN_GET_LOCAL_DATE_STR(B.PUBL_DATE, #{locale}) AS PUBL_DATE , G.BOOK_AVG_GRDE FROM TM_REPORT A LEFT JOIN TM_BKINFO B ON A.BOOK_NUMB = B.BOOK_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT L.TAGT_NUMB AS REPT_NUMB , COUNT(*) AS LIKE_CNT FROM TB_LIKEXX L INNER JOIN TM_USERXM LU ON LU.USER_NUMB = L.USER_NUMB AND LU.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} WHERE L.TAGT_TYPE = #{likeTargetReport} GROUP BY L.TAGT_NUMB ) LC ON A.REPT_NUMB = LC.REPT_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT L.TAGT_NUMB AS REPT_NUMB , #{commYes} AS LIKE_YSNO FROM TB_LIKEXX L WHERE L.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND L.TAGT_TYPE = #{likeTargetReport} ) UL ON A.REPT_NUMB = UL.REPT_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P.BOOK_NUMB , ROUND(AVG(CAST(P.REPT_GRDE AS UNSIGNED)), 1) AS BOOK_AVG_GRDE FROM TM_REPORT P WHERE P.REPT_STAT = #{reptStat} GROUP BY P.BOOK_NUMB ) G ON G.BOOK_NUMB = B.BOOK_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT R.TAGT_NUMB AS REPT_NUMB , COUNT(*) AS REPL_CNT FROM TB_REPLXX R WHERE R.TAGT_TYPE = 'REPORT' GROUP BY R.TAGT_NUMB ) RC ON RC.REPT_NUMB = A.REPT_NUMB WHERE A.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND A.REPT_NUMB = #{reptNumb}

SELECT /* getReportByIsbnDtl */ R.REPT_NUMB , B.BOOK_ISBN FROM TM_REPORT R INNER JOIN TM_BKINFO B ON B.BOOK_NUMB = R.BOOK_NUMB WHERE R.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND B.BOOK_ISBN = #{bookIsbn} ORDER BY R.REPT_NUMB DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT /* getPublicReportList */ P.REPT_NUMB , P.USER_NUMB , U.USER_NICK , F.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , P.BOOK_NUMB , P.LANG_CODE , P.REPT_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{codeReadStat}, P.REPT_STAT, NULL, #{languageCode}) AS REPT_STAT_NAME , P.REPT_GRDE , P.REPT_CNTN , P.PUBC_YSNO , COALESCE(LC.LIKE_CNT, 0) AS LIKE_CNT , COALESCE(UL.LIKE_YSNO, #{commNo}) AS LIKE_YSNO , COALESCE(RPL.REPL_CNT, 0) AS REPL_CNT , CASE WHEN FW.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL THEN #{commYes} ELSE #{commNo} END AS FOLLOW_YSNO , CASE WHEN T.ORIG_HASH = SHA2(COALESCE(P.REPT_CNTN, ''), 256) THEN #{commYes} ELSE #{commNo} END AS TRNS_CACHE_YSNO FROM TM_BKINFO B INNER JOIN TM_REPORT P ON B.BOOK_NUMB = P.BOOK_NUMB INNER JOIN TM_USERXM U ON P.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON U.PROF_NUMB = F.FILE_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_REPTRN T ON T.REPT_NUMB = P.REPT_NUMB AND T.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} LEFT JOIN TB_FOLLOW FW ON FW.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND FW.FLOW_NUMB = P.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_FOLLOW RF ON RF.USER_NUMB = P.USER_NUMB AND RF.FLOW_NUMB = #{userNumb} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT L.TAGT_NUMB AS REPT_NUMB , COUNT(*) AS LIKE_CNT FROM TB_LIKEXX L INNER JOIN TM_USERXM LU ON LU.USER_NUMB = L.USER_NUMB AND LU.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} INNER JOIN TM_REPORT LR ON LR.REPT_NUMB = L.TAGT_NUMB INNER JOIN TM_BKINFO LB ON LB.BOOK_NUMB = LR.BOOK_NUMB WHERE L.TAGT_TYPE = #{likeTargetReport} AND LB.BOOK_ISBN = #{bookIsbn} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USBLOC BLOCKX WHERE (BLOCKX.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND BLOCKX.BLOC_NUMB = L.USER_NUMB) OR (BLOCKX.USER_NUMB = L.USER_NUMB AND BLOCKX.BLOC_NUMB = #{userNumb}) ) GROUP BY L.TAGT_NUMB ) LC ON LC.REPT_NUMB = P.REPT_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT L.TAGT_NUMB AS REPT_NUMB , #{commYes} AS LIKE_YSNO FROM TB_LIKEXX L WHERE L.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND L.TAGT_TYPE = #{likeTargetReport} ) UL ON UL.REPT_NUMB = P.REPT_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT R.TAGT_NUMB AS REPT_NUMB , COUNT(*) AS REPL_CNT FROM TB_REPLXX R INNER JOIN TM_REPORT RR ON RR.REPT_NUMB = R.TAGT_NUMB INNER JOIN TM_BKINFO RB ON RB.BOOK_NUMB = RR.BOOK_NUMB WHERE RB.BOOK_ISBN = #{bookIsbn} AND R.TAGT_TYPE = #{likeTargetReport} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USBLOC BLOCKX WHERE (BLOCKX.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND BLOCKX.BLOC_NUMB = R.USER_NUMB) OR (BLOCKX.USER_NUMB = R.USER_NUMB AND BLOCKX.BLOC_NUMB = #{userNumb}) ) GROUP BY R.TAGT_NUMB ) RPL ON RPL.REPT_NUMB = P.REPT_NUMB WHERE P.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} AND P.PUBC_YSNO = #{commYes} AND P.REPT_STAT != #{reptStatRead} AND B.BOOK_ISBN = #{bookIsbn} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USBLOC BLOCKX WHERE (BLOCKX.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND BLOCKX.BLOC_NUMB = P.USER_NUMB) OR (BLOCKX.USER_NUMB = P.USER_NUMB AND BLOCKX.BLOC_NUMB = #{userNumb}) )
AND P.REPT_STAT = #{reptStat}
ORDER BY P.REPT_NUMB DESC
ORDER BY CAST(P.REPT_GRDE AS DECIMAL(3, 1)) DESC , P.REPT_NUMB DESC
ORDER BY COALESCE(LC.LIKE_CNT, 0) DESC , P.REPT_NUMB DESC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN FW.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL AND RF.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL THEN 0 WHEN FW.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END , P.REPT_NUMB DESC
LIMIT #{pageOffset}, #{pageLimit}

SELECT /* getPublicReportTarget */ P.REPT_NUMB , P.USER_NUMB , U.USER_NICK , PF.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , P.BOOK_NUMB , P.LANG_CODE , P.REPT_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{codeReadStat}, P.REPT_STAT, NULL, #{languageCode}) AS REPT_STAT_NAME , P.REPT_GRDE , P.REPT_CNTN , P.PUBC_YSNO , B.BOOK_TITL , B.BOOK_ATHR , B.BOOK_PUBL , B.BOOK_ISBN , B.BOOK_CVIM , B.BOOK_DESC , B.PUBL_DATE , (SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(AVG_REPORT.REPT_GRDE AS UNSIGNED)), 1) FROM TM_REPORT AVG_REPORT WHERE AVG_REPORT.BOOK_NUMB = P.BOOK_NUMB AND AVG_REPORT.REPT_STAT != #{reptStatRead}) AS BOOK_AVG_GRDE , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LIKEXX L JOIN TM_USERXM LU ON LU.USER_NUMB = L.USER_NUMB AND LU.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} WHERE L.TAGT_TYPE = #{likeTargetReport} AND L.TAGT_NUMB = P.REPT_NUMB AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USBLOC BLOCKX WHERE (BLOCKX.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND BLOCKX.BLOC_NUMB = L.USER_NUMB) OR (BLOCKX.USER_NUMB = L.USER_NUMB AND BLOCKX.BLOC_NUMB = #{userNumb}) )) AS LIKE_CNT , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LIKEXX L WHERE L.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND L.TAGT_TYPE = #{likeTargetReport} AND L.TAGT_NUMB = P.REPT_NUMB ) THEN #{commYes} ELSE #{commNo} END AS LIKE_YSNO , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_REPLXX R WHERE R.TAGT_TYPE = #{likeTargetReport} AND R.TAGT_NUMB = P.REPT_NUMB AND R.DELT_YSNO = #{commNo} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USBLOC BLOCKX WHERE (BLOCKX.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND BLOCKX.BLOC_NUMB = R.USER_NUMB) OR (BLOCKX.USER_NUMB = R.USER_NUMB AND BLOCKX.BLOC_NUMB = #{userNumb}) )) AS REPL_CNT , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_FOLLOW F WHERE F.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND F.FLOW_NUMB = P.USER_NUMB ) THEN #{commYes} ELSE #{commNo} END AS FOLLOW_YSNO , CASE WHEN T.ORIG_HASH = SHA2(COALESCE(P.REPT_CNTN, ''), 256) THEN #{commYes} ELSE #{commNo} END AS TRNS_CACHE_YSNO FROM TM_REPORT P JOIN TM_BKINFO B ON B.BOOK_NUMB = P.BOOK_NUMB JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = P.USER_NUMB AND U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} JOIN TM_USERXM ACTOR ON ACTOR.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND ACTOR.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM PF ON PF.FILE_NUMB = U.PROF_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_REPTRN T ON T.REPT_NUMB = P.REPT_NUMB AND T.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} WHERE P.REPT_NUMB = #{reptNumb} AND P.PUBC_YSNO = #{commYes} AND P.REPT_STAT != #{reptStatRead} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USBLOC BLOCKX WHERE (BLOCKX.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND BLOCKX.BLOC_NUMB = P.USER_NUMB) OR (BLOCKX.USER_NUMB = P.USER_NUMB AND BLOCKX.BLOC_NUMB = #{userNumb}) )
SELECT /* getReportTrnsDtl */ T.REPT_NUMB , T.LANG_CODE , T.ORIG_HASH , T.TRNS_CNTN FROM TB_REPTRN T WHERE T.REPT_NUMB = #{reptNumb} AND T.LANG_CODE = #{langCode}

SELECT /* getPublicRatingAvgByIsbn */ ROUND(AVG(CAST(P.REPT_GRDE AS UNSIGNED)), 1) FROM TM_BKINFO B INNER JOIN TM_REPORT P ON B.BOOK_NUMB = P.BOOK_NUMB WHERE B.BOOK_ISBN = #{bookIsbn} AND P.REPT_STAT != #{reptStatRead}
mapper.update: UPDATE /* uptClubReadingDropout */ TB_CLPART PART JOIN TM_CLRNDX ROUNDX ON ROUNDX.CLUB_NUMB = PART.CLUB_NUMB AND ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB = PART.ROND_NUMB JOIN TB_CLMEMX MEMBER ON MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = PART.CLUB_NUMB AND MEMBER.USER_NUMB = PART.USER_NUMB JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = PART.USER_NUMB JOIN TM_REPORT REPORT ON REPORT.REPT_NUMB = PART.REPT_NUMB AND REPORT.USER_NUMB = PART.USER_NUMB SET PART.GOAL_YSNO = #{commNo} , PART.ACHV_DATE = NULL , PART.UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE PART.REPT_NUMB = #{reptNumb} AND PART.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND PART.GOAL_YSNO IS NULL AND ROUNDX.ROND_STAT = #{roundReading} AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberActive} AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{userActive}
mapper.delete: DELETE /* delReportChildReplies */ C FROM TB_REPLXX C INNER JOIN TM_REPORT P ON P.REPT_NUMB = C.TAGT_NUMB AND P.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} WHERE C.TAGT_TYPE = 'REPORT' AND C.TAGT_NUMB = #{reptNumb} AND C.UPER_NUMB IS NOT NULL
DELETE /* delReportReplies */ R FROM TB_REPLXX R INNER JOIN TM_REPORT P ON P.REPT_NUMB = R.TAGT_NUMB AND P.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} WHERE R.TAGT_TYPE = 'REPORT' AND R.TAGT_NUMB = #{reptNumb}
